units.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns

topics.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns

subtopics.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns (1 of 4)

outcomes.text: Performs locomotor skills (walking, hopping, galloping, running, sliding, skipping) while maintaining balance.
Performs jumping and landing actions with balance (horizontal).
Performs jumping and landing actions with balance (vertical).
Performs locomotor skills in response to teacher-led creative rhythms.
Maintains momentary stillness on different bases of support (e.g., one body part, combinations of body parts, wide base, narrow base).

subtopics.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns (2 of 4)

outcomes.text: Forms wide, narrow, curled and twisted body shapes.
Rolls sideways in a narrow body shape.
Contrasts the actions of curling and stretching.
Throws underhand with opposite foot forward.
Drops a ball and catches it before it bounces twice.

subtopics.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns (3 of 4)

outcomes.text: Catches a large ball tossed by a skilled thrower.
Dribbles a ball with one hand, attempting the second contact.
Taps a ball using the inside of the foot, sending it forward.
Kicks a stationary ball from a stationary position, demonstrating two of the five elements of a mature kicking pattern.
Volleys a lightweight object (balloon), sending it upward.

subtopics.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns (4 of 4)

outcomes.text: Strikes a lightweight object with a paddle or short-handled racket.
Executes a single jump with self-turned rope.
Jumps a long rope with teacher-assisted turning.

Jumps a long rope five times consecutively with skilled turners.

subtopics.title: Demonstrates competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns (2 of 5)

outcomes.text: Performs a sequence of locomotor skills, transitioning from one skill to another smoothly and without hesitation (e.g., hop, skip, jump forward/backward).

outcomes.text: Combines locomotor skills and movement concepts (e.g., levels, shapes, extensions, pathways, force, time, flow) to create and perform a dance/rhythmic movement.

Strikes a ball with a long-handled implement, sending it forward, while using proper grip for the implement (e.g., hockey stick, bat, golf club).

Combines traveling with the manipulative skills of dribbling, throwing, catching and striking in teacher-and/or student-designed, small-sided, practice-task environments.

Demonstrates appropriate technique in resistance-training machines and free weights.
Relates physiological responses to individual levels of fitness and nutritional balance

Applies stress-management strategies (e.g., mental imagery, relaxation techniques, deep breathing, aerobic exercise, meditation) to reduce stress.
